# Loading the packages

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(colorspace)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(circlize)
library(ggvenn)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
```

# Loading the data

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Viral abundance data
virus_tab = read_xlsx("virus_tab.xlsx", col_names = T)
virus_tab = column_to_rownames(virus_tab, "Taxon")

# Clinicopathological data
sampleTable = read_xlsx("clinical_data.xlsx")
sampleTable = sampleTable[sampleTable$samples_diego %in% 
                          colnames(virus_tab), ]

# Viral classification data
virus_hosp = read_xlsx("virus_hosp.xlsx", col_names = T)
```

# Viral composition

## Hierarchical classification of viral composition

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
# Preparing the data
df = virus_hosp %>%
  count(Virus_Group, Genome_Type, Taxon, name = "n")

# Totals by level
lvl1 = df %>%
  group_by(Virus_Group) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")
lvl2 = df %>%
  group_by(Virus_Group, Genome_Type) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop")
lvl3 = df

# Ordering
lvl3 = lvl3 %>%
  arrange(Virus_Group, Genome_Type, desc(n))
lvl2 = lvl2 %>%
  arrange(Virus_Group, Genome_Type)

# Cumulative coordinates
lvl2 = lvl2 %>%
  arrange(Virus_Group, Genome_Type) %>%
  group_by(Virus_Group) %>%
  mutate(xmin = cumsum(lag(n, default = 0)), xmax = cumsum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()
lvl3 = lvl3 %>%
  arrange(Virus_Group, Genome_Type, desc(n)) %>%
  group_by(Virus_Group) %>%
  mutate(xmin = cumsum(lag(n, default = 0)),xmax = cumsum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Defining the colors
base_colors = c("Bacteriophages" = "#3E7C93", 
                "Eukaryotic viruses" = "orange4")
adjust_color <- function(color, genome){
  if(genome == "dsDNA") return(lighten(color, 0.2))
  if(genome == "ssDNA") return(lighten(color, 0.25))
  if(genome == "ssRNA") return(lighten(color, 0.3))
  return(color)
}

# Initializing the circos plot
circos.clear()
circos.par(gap.degree = 0, 
           track.margin = c(0, 0), 
           cell.padding = c(0, 0, 0, 0))
circos.initialize(factors = lvl1$Virus_Group, 
                  xlim = cbind(rep(0, nrow(lvl1)), lvl1$n))

# Track 1 (Outer) → Taxon
circos.trackPlotRegion(
  ylim = c(0, 1),
  track.height = 0.3,
  panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    sector = get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
    sub <- lvl3 %>% filter(Virus_Group == sector)
    
    for(i in 1:nrow(sub)){
      
      xstart = sub$xmin[i]
      xend   = sub$xmax[i]
      genome = sub$Genome_Type[i]
      genus  = sub$Taxon[i]
      col = adjust_color(base_colors[sector], genome)
      circos.rect(xstart, 0, xend, 1, col = col, border = NA)
      
      if((xend - xstart) > max(sub$n) * 0.05){
        circos.text((xstart + xend)/2, 0.5, genus,
                    facing = "clockwise",
                    niceFacing = TRUE,
                    cex = 0.6,
                    col = "white")}}},
  bg.border = NA)

# Track 2 (Middle) → Genome_Type
circos.trackPlotRegion(
  ylim = c(0, 1),
    panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    sector = get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
    sub <- lvl2 %>% filter(Virus_Group == sector)
    
    for(i in 1:nrow(sub)){
      
      xstart = sub$xmin[i]
      xend   = sub$xmax[i]
      genome = sub$Genome_Type[i]
      col = adjust_color(base_colors[sector], genome)
      circos.rect(xstart, 0, xend, 1,
                  col = col, border = "white")
      circos.text((xstart + xend)/2, 0.5, genome,
                  facing = "inside",
                  niceFacing = TRUE,
                  cex = 0.8,
                  col = "white")}},
  bg.border = NA)

# Track 3 (Inner) → Virus_Group
circos.trackPlotRegion(
  ylim = c(0, 1),
  panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    sector = get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
    xlim = get.cell.meta.data("xlim")
    circos.rect(xlim[1], 0, xlim[2], 1,
                col = base_colors[sector],
                border = NA)
    circos.text(mean(xlim), 0.5, sector,
                facing = "outside",
                niceFacing = TRUE,
                cex = 1,
                col = "white")},
  bg.border = NA)
```

## Distribution of viruses by viral group and genome type

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Calculating absolute and relative frequencies of viral groups
freq_group = virus_hosp %>%
  count(Virus_Group, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percent = (n / sum(n)) * 100)

# Calculating absolute and relative frequencies of genome types
freq_genome = virus_hosp %>%
  count(Genome_Type, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percent = (n / sum(n)) * 100)

# Viral group barplot
p_group = ggplot(freq_group, aes(x = Virus_Group, y = percent, fill = Virus_Group)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Bacteriophages" = "#3E7C93", 
                               "Eukaryotic viruses" = "orange4")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(x = "Virus_Group", y = "Frequency (%)", fill = "Virus_Group") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent)),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"), 
        legend.position = "none", 
        strip.text = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10))

# Genome type barplot
p_genome = ggplot(freq_genome, aes(x = Genome_Type, y = percent, fill = Genome_Type)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("DNA" = "#0868AC", 
                               "RNA" = "#A50F15")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100)) +
  labs(x = "Genome_Type", y = "Frequency (%)", fill = "Genome_Type") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent)),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"), 
        legend.position = "none", 
        strip.text = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "black", size = 10), 
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 10), 
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 10))

# Barplots
grid.arrange(p_group, p_genome, ncol = 2)
```

## Venn diagram

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Creating metadata containing only tissue information
metadata = data.frame(Samples = sampleTable$samples_diego,
                      Tissue = sampleTable$Tissue)

# Merging the abundance table with the metadata
virus_tab_2 = as.data.frame(t(virus_tab))
virus_tab_2$Samples = row.names(virus_tab_2)
virus_tab_2 = merge(virus_tab_2, metadata, by.x = "Samples")

# Separating the GC group
virus_tab_GC = filter(virus_tab_2, Tissue == "GC")
rownames(virus_tab_GC) = virus_tab_GC$Samples
virus_tab_GC = select(virus_tab_GC, -Samples, -Tissue)

# Separating the NT group
virus_tab_NT = filter(virus_tab_2, Tissue == "NT")
rownames(virus_tab_NT) = virus_tab_NT$Samples
virus_tab_NT = select(virus_tab_NT, -Samples, -Tissue)

# Obtaining the taxa present in each group and creating a list
GC_taxons = colnames(virus_tab_GC)[colSums(virus_tab_GC) > 0]
NT_taxons = colnames(virus_tab_NT)[colSums(virus_tab_NT) > 0]
list_taxons = list("GC" = GC_taxons, "NT" = NT_taxons)

# Venn diagram
venn_plot = ggvenn(list_taxons, 
       fill_color = c("#67000D","#2B7A78"),
       stroke_color = NA, 
       stroke_size = 0.5,
       fill_alpha = 0.8,
       text_size = ,                                    
       text_color = "white",                                
       set_name_size = 6,                             
       set_name_color = "black")
print(venn_plot)
```

## Overall relative abundance pattern

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Preparing and transposing the abundance matrix
virus_tab_T <- virus_tab_2 %>%
  filter(Tissue %in% c("GC", "NT")) %>%
  select(-Tissue) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Samples")
virus_tab_T <- as.matrix(virus_tab_T)   # samples x viruses

# GC and NT tissue metadata
metadata <- metadata %>%
  filter(Samples %in% rownames(virus_tab_T)) %>%
  arrange(match(Samples, rownames(virus_tab_T)))
virus_tab_T <- virus_tab_T[metadata$Samples, ]

# Virus information aligned with the columns
virus_info <- virus_hosp[match(colnames(virus_tab_T), virus_hosp$Taxon), ]
virus_info$Virus_Group <- as.character(virus_info$Virus_Group)
virus_info$Genome_Type <- as.character(virus_info$Genome_Type)

# Log10 transformation
virus_tab_T <- log10(virus_tab_T + 1e-2)

# Abundance range colors
col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-2, -1, 0, 2),
  c("#FFFFFF", "#FDD0A2", "#E34A33", "#A50F15"))

# Side annotation (Tissue) - rows
row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  Tissue = metadata$Tissue,
  col = list(Tissue = c("GC" = "#67000D", "NT" = "#2B7A78")),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  show_legend = FALSE)

# Top annotation (Virus_Group and Genome_Type) - columns
col_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Virus_Group = virus_info$Virus_Group,
  Genome_Type = virus_info$Genome_Type,
  col = list(
    Virus_Group = c("Bacteriophages" = "#3E7C93",
                    "Eukaryotic viruses" = "orange4"),
    Genome_Type = c("DNA" = "#0868AC",
                    "RNA" = "#A50F15")),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  show_legend = FALSE)

# Splits (without mixing annotations)
row_split <- metadata$Tissue
col_split <- interaction(virus_info$Virus_Group, virus_info$Genome_Type, drop = TRUE)

# Heatmap
ht <- Heatmap(
  virus_tab_T,
  name = "Abundance",
  col = col_fun,
  top_annotation = col_ha,
  left_annotation = row_ha,
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  show_row_names = FALSE,
  show_column_names = TRUE,
  column_names_side = "bottom",
  column_names_rot = 45,
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "italic"),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_split = row_split,
  column_split = col_split,
  column_title = NULL,
  row_title = NULL,
  border = TRUE)

# Legends (4 stacked)
lgd_tissue <- Legend(
  title = "Tissue",
  at = c("GC","NT"),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = c("#67000D", "#2B7A78")))

lgd_group <- Legend(
  title = "Virus_Group",
  at = c("Bacteriophages","Eukaryotic viruses"),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = c("#3E7C93", "orange4")))

lgd_genome <- Legend(
  title = "Genome_Type",
  at = c("DNA","RNA"),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = c("#0868AC","#A50F15")))

lgd_heatmap <- Legend(
  col_fun = col_fun,
  title = "Abundance")

lgd_combined <- packLegend(
  lgd_tissue,
  lgd_group,
  lgd_genome,
  lgd_heatmap,
  direction = "vertical",
  gap = unit(3, "mm"))

# Plotting the heatmap
draw(ht, 
     heatmap_legend_side = "right",
     annotation_legend_side = "right",
     show_heatmap_legend = TRUE,
     show_annotation_legend = TRUE,
     annotation_legend_list = list(lgd_combined))
```
